g.text: — no state changes without explicit approval
Describe what to investigate. Kratos reasons through it step by step and asks
Tips: ? help · Ctrl+P commands · ↑/↓ edit a previous turn · Ctrl+B session list
· /compact free context · esc or Ctrl+C stops a response
Or just ask: “switch to <model>”, “change the target to <host>”, “show the
report” — Kratos confirms before changing its model or target.
Investigations target the monitored host by default; ask about “your own host”
(or /investigate-host) to check the Kratos machine itself.
why did the gateway lock out an account
Open network ports were found — this is the system's attack surface.
A burst of login failures was observed in a short window.
[AUTH-004] Burst of 14 failed logins in 40s on the gateway
